alt: Markdown objects under markdown_files/ in the OCI Object Storage bucket cocoindex-example-data are listed, chunked with RecursiveSplitter and embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into the Postgres table coco_examples.oci_object_storage_doc_embeddings; in live mode an event on the OCI Streaming topic cocoindex-example-data-events for rfc8259.md makes the connector re-read the object with head_object and update its rows, or delete them on a 404.
